newsitem.title: USA: EXEC BEHIND COLUMBIA AD CAMPAIGN RESIGNS.
newsitem.headline: EXEC BEHIND COLUMBIA AD CAMPAIGN RESIGNS.

text.p: The Columbia/HCA Healthcare Corp executive in charge of a costly national advertising campaign that is now being dropped has stepped down, the company said.
Lindy Richardson, a close ally of ousted former chief executive Richard Scott, has resigned her position, said company spokeswoman Eve Hutcherson.
The national branding campaign, which has involved numerous costly and high-profile advertisements in national newspapers and magazines, is being abandoned, newly appointed CEO Dr. Thomas Frist said.

Frist has been publicly critical of the campaign, which he said he considers ill-conceived. He said the company will return to a grass-roots strategy of promoting individual hospitals, rather than a national image.
